_comment: content10h design_lean (3 Nov 2026): the LEAN design of docs/content-10h/designs/lean.md for tools/sim/content10h.py (design prototype; not used by the game or the gates). PHASE 1 (before the soft launch) = this file as it stands: NH 44 and NH 48 exactly as today, then NH 19 (UP - Bihar) and NH 44 South (Tamil Nadu) made the NH 48 way (family layout from the start, menus a 1.0 factor, the same price-to-cost ratio as NH 48: cost_mult = mult / 1.5). Each new highway also needs Izzat EARNED in all (never spent: earning only counts up): 50 for NH 19, 85 for NH 44 South. Izzat is earned at milestones, per counter-mastery star and per baraat step, and spent on 5 perks. Mastery is PER COUNTER (all its dishes on every highway count): stars at 20, 60, 150, 300, 500, 750, 1000 plates, then one more every 200 plates up to 100 stars; +1 % on that counter's prices per star, for at most 50 stars. No hotel in phase 1. PHASE 2 (after the soft-launch data) = content.phase2, merged only by the lean copy of the tool with --phase 2: a lean Truckers' Rest stage after the family stage on every highway (its own module, 6 bays to level 6), NH 66 Konkan and NH 16 Odisha, a festival week. The official tool ignores content.phase2 and the keys tail, counter_price_per_star and counter_price_cap_stars, and runs scope 'counter' as scope 'slot': use the lean copy for this design's numbers (lean.md section 2 gives the commands). All money in ref units (x10 on screen).

old_staff.name: Old staff: +1 waiter on a new highway

seed_money.name: Seed money: start a new highway with 500 x its price mult a level

quick_hands.name: Quick hands: cooks 5 % faster a level

fast_feet.name: Fast feet: waiters 5 % faster a level

good_name.name: Good name: every price +4 % a level

fund._comment: Village fund (lean copy only): step n costs 30 x 1.05^n minutes of the reward rate and pays 1 Izzat; the bot buys it only when every counter is at its max level (the sink of a maxed dhaba).

phase2._comment: After the soft-launch data. Replaces the highway list (every move now also needs the highway's Truckers' Rest full: hotel_done), turns on the lean hotel stage, adds a hotel perk and one festival week (day 8, as an example date).

hotel._comment: Truckers' Rest: a roofed deck on the rear block with charpai bays for overnight truckers. Opens when the family stage has all 16 dishes, for 12,500 x the highway's price mult; 2 bays come with it, 6 in all, each to level 6. A bay at level L pays 300 x 1.3^(L-1) x the price mult a night (about a quarter of the dhaba's takings when NH 44's is full), 85 % full; one night = one day cycle of play (600 s), paid at dawn. Full = 6 bays at level 6. Away: 1/4 of its pay for up to 8 h.

soft_charpai.name: Soft charpais: Truckers' Rest pays 10 % more a level
